title: Histomorphometric and Clinical Analysis of Ridge Preservation Procedures in Extraction Sockets with Buccal Bone Defects (>5mm) Using an In Situ Hardening Biphasic Calcium Phosphate (HA/β-TCP) Graft and a Bioresorbable Matrix: A Human Study at 6 Months
authors: Alfonsi F, Baldi N, Romeggio S, Tonelli P, Iezzi G, Velasco -Ortega E, Barone A. Appl Sciences. 2020 Apr; 10(9):3034. doi: 10.3390/app10093034. 33 * collafleece®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “, this prospective cohort study showed encouraging results in preserving alveolar ridge dimension. A moderate percentage of new bone and an acceptable alveolar ridge loss were achieved at a 6 month follow-up” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
